title: VEEA INC. 8-K Filing — Notice of Delisting or Failure to Satisfy Continued Listing Rule or Standard; Transfer of Listing
summary: Veea Inc. (VEEA), a small-cap technology company, received Nasdaq approval on April 7, 2026 to transfer its listing from the Nasdaq Global Market to the Nasdaq Capital Market due to failure to maintain minimum bid price ($1.00 threshold) and market value requirements. The transfer took effect April 9, 2026 and the company was granted until September 28, 2026 to regain compliance with the minimum bid price requirement.
key_points: Veea Inc. (ticker: VEEA) is a Delaware corporation listed on Nasdaq with common stock and warrants

The company received Nasdaq deficiency notices on September 29, 2025 for failing to meet minimum bid price ($1.00), market value of publicly held shares ($15M), and market value of listed securities ($50M) requirements
On March 27, 2026, the company applied to transfer from Nasdaq Global Market to Nasdaq Capital Market
Nasdaq approved the transfer on April 7, 2026; effective at market open on April 9, 2026
The company received a second 180-day compliance period extending to September 28, 2026 to meet the minimum bid price requirement
Trading continued uninterrupted under symbols VEEA and VEEAW during and after the transfer
